blurb: Tucked away in the small town of Blum, TX, Stonebridge is a 40-acre property along the beautiful Nolan River. It’s only a short 45-minute drive from Fort Worth and a mere hour from Dallas and Waco. Upon arrival, though, city life will soon begin to fade. Once you step foot on the grounds, your eyes will instantly be drawn to one of the largest and oldest live oak trees in the great state of Texas.
